paper_title: The Effects of Electronic Cigarettes on Oral Microbiome and Metabolome in 3D Tissue-Engineered Models
skip_reason: This is an in vitro treatment intervention study using 3D tissue-engineered oral mucosa models (OMMs) infected with oral microbes from a healthy donor and then exposed to electronic cigarette (EC) aerosol (flavoured with and without nicotine). The study does not compare a disease patient group against a healthy control group. Instead, it compares EC-exposed laboratory models to unexposed laboratory controls. There is no clinical disease cohort present in this study.
